source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Professor X (archived 4 May 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Born a mutant, later confirmed an Omega-level telepath; his telekinesis fully awakened only late in life.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.detail: Reads and projects thoughts across about 250 miles, further with great effort. Linked to Cerebro, he can reach every mind on the planet.

abilities.name: Mind control
abilities.detail: Takes over, possesses or shuts down other minds, sometimes several at once, and can erase or alter memories.

abilities.name: Illusions and mental cloaking
abilities.detail: Makes people experience events that are not happening, and hides himself or others from sight and from other telepaths.

abilities.name: Psionic blasts
abilities.detail: Mental bolts that cause pain, unconsciousness or worse; at full force his thoughts have struck a Sentinel with physical power.

abilities.name: Astral projection
abilities.detail: Leaves his body to travel and communicate on the astral plane, where he can shape objects from thought.

abilities.name: Telepathic teaching
abilities.detail: Plants knowledge directly into minds, such as teaching the X-Men Russian or packing months of training into a few hours.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.detail: Once only faint, his telekinesis later fully awakened, strong enough to shield him from several exploding missiles.

abilities.name: Genius scientist and strategist
abilities.detail: A leading authority on genetics, mutation and psionics who builds mind-boosting equipment and plans long campaigns against foes such as Magneto and Apocalypse.

feats.text: As a young traveller in Cairo, he beat the Shadow King, Amahl Farouk, in a duel on the astral plane.
After Magneto tore the adamantium from Wolverine, Xavier shut down Magneto's mind, leaving his old friend in a vegetative state.
Inside an Orchis base, he unleashed a psionic storm that put Nimrod, the most advanced Sentinel, out of the fight.
Used Cerebro to find the runaway Rogue at a train station.
An uncontrolled psychic seizure froze everyone in an Oklahoma City hotel in place, letting Logan take down the Reavers.
As Earth-838's Xavier, he entered the Scarlet Witch's mind to try to free that world's Wanda, but she overpowered him.
feats.where: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)
